theme.name: Woodex Master Theme
theme.description: Section-template + page-template driven HTML5 master theme for Woodex Interior.
theme.framework: Zero-dependency static HTML5 + vanilla JS + JSON content API

site._comment: Set site.url to your production origin (e.g. https://woodexinterior.pk) to switch on canonical + og:url, sitemap.xml and robots.txt in one step. Left empty deliberately: a wrong canonical is worse than none, because it tells search engines the page duplicates a URL that does not exist.
